caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, symmetrical floral motif featuring a central red stem with curving branches and leaves. The midsection of the stem is intersected by a horizontal blue rectangular band containing a lattice pattern. At the top of the stem, there are large, ornate red leaves or petals with yellow and blue accents. On each side of the central stem, extending outward, are two large, bulb-like shapes resembling flowers or seed pods, primarily colored in yellow with blue and red details outlined in red. Below the blue band, there are two symmetrical blue elements, each resembling a curling leaf or decorative flourish, accompanied by small yellow accents. The background is plain and off-white, and the overall composition is balanced with clear bilateral symmetry. The colors used are predominantly red, yellow, and blue.
title: Design from Proposed Portfolio
